## About
We are a truck repair shop on Forest Parkway in Lake City. We started out as a single-truck mobile service and grew into a full-service repair facility staffed by ASE-certified technicians.
We know your trucks are how you make a living, so we work to keep downtime short and keep you in the loop on every repair. One reviewer called us a family owned business, and that is how we try to treat the drivers and owners who come through our doors.
Our customers rate us 4.8 on Google from 104 reviews.

## Services
- Preventative maintenance: Regular servicing to keep your trucks running smoothly and efficiently.
- Brake repair and services: Brake inspections, repairs and upkeep so your trucks stop safely.
- Transmission repair and services: Diagnostics and repairs for both manual and automatic transmissions, including rebuilds.
- Engine services: Engine work for medium-duty diesel trucks, from regular maintenance to bigger jobs.
- Diesel particulate filters and exhaust: Repair and maintenance for diesel exhaust systems, including DPF work.
- DOT inspections: Inspections to check that your medium-duty diesel trucks meet federal safety and compliance standards.

## FAQ
Q: What trucks do you work on?
A: We specialize in Isuzu and work on all truck brands, with diagnostic software for Hino, International, Isuzu and Freightliner.

Q: Is the work covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. Repairs come with a 30-day labor warranty, and parts carry a manufacturer-backed warranty.

Q: Can I drop my truck off after hours?
A: Yes. We offer after-hours drop-off so you can bring your truck in when it fits your schedule. Give us a call to set it up.
